fusions.name: Wrench It Open
fusions.desc: Grips the target and tears at its plate, dealing 8 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flung Buckler
fusions.desc: Hurls your shield, dealing 12 damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Chest-Beating Challenge
fusions.desc: You pound your breastplate and draw up to 5 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Grudge Fists
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
